title: GitHub-first trading concept skill library
decision: Expose one repository router skill and keep each concept as an individually installable, self-contained catalog skill outside automatic discovery.
rationale: Skills package reusable workflows; the existing concept JSON remains the factual source of truth.
A 1,500-skill discovery list can exceed the host metadata budget and cause descriptions or skills to be omitted.
A router preserves reliable discovery while individual catalog packages remain portable and directly readable from GitHub.
Generated concept references carry canonical hashes so duplicated package data cannot silently drift.

prohibited: claims of certainty or guaranteed profitability
presentation of educational analysis as personalized financial advice

batching.order: core-perps concepts by master_index, then all remaining concepts by master_index
batching.deployment: validate, commit, push, and verify GitHub Pages after every batch

sources.section: Progressive disclosure, skill anatomy, discovery locations, and best practices
MCP connects models to external tools and context

warning: Built with AI systems. Concept skills provide educational research and decision support, not financial advice, execution, or evidence of profitability.
